references.text: The altar was to have horns at each corner, and it was to be covered with bronze, which connects to the use of bronze as a material in the sanctuary.
Describes how the burnt offering altar was made with bronze, the same material used to cover the altar with the fire pans.
The direct context where God commands that the fire pans of those who sinned be hammered out into plates to serve as a covering for the altar.
Parallel verses describing the same event where Eleazar gathered the fire pans and hammered them out into a covering for the altar.
Nadab and Abihu offered unauthorized fire and were consumed, a similar judgment that fell upon Korah's followers who had offered incense.
Solomon consecrated the central part of the courtyard for sacrifices, highlighting the altar's central role in worship.
